verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦਾਸਣ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: brahame thake bedh paR i(n)dhr i(n)dhaasan raaj kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Many Brahmas reciting Vedas and many Indrs ruling the kingdoms got tired.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਂਦੇਵ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਹੋਇ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਭਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: mahaa(n)dhev avadhoot hoi dhas avataaree bisan bhava(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Mahadev becoming recluse and Visnu assuming ten incarnations roamed hither and thither.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗੀਸਰਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਭੇਵ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sidh naath jogeesaraa dhevee dhev na bhev laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Siddhs, naths, chiefs of the yogis, gods and goddesses could not know the mystery of that Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਤੀਰਥਾ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: tape tapeesur teerathaa jatee satee dheh dhukh saha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Ascetics, the people going to pilgrimage centres, celebates and numerous satis in order to know Him suffer through their bodies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਨਾਗ ਸਭ ਰਾਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sekhanaag sabh raag mil simaran kar nit gun gaava(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Sesanag also along with all musical measures remembers and praises Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: vaddabhaagee gursikh jag sabadh surat satasa(n)g mila(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In this world only gurmukhs are fortunate who merging their consciousness in the Word gather in holy congregation.
Gurmukhs only, become face to face with that imperceptible Lord and attain the fruit of delight.
